jobs.employer_name: Weierstraß-Institut für Angewandte Analysis und Stochastik (WIAS)
jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations ”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027 .Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!

continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.
